summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for BYOKGPT enhancements:
- Web Search & In-App Browser overhaul with single persistent Settings toggle, subtle active mode indicator, separate chat histories for Normal and Web sessions, and direct web content summarization
- Removal of both globe icons (composer toggle and top bar quick language chip)
- Removal of AI response bubble box for a modern, borderless layout while retaining user message bubbles
- Functional Long-term Memory Summary with automatic background extraction, manual add/edit/delete, and Room persistence
- Expanded file parser supporting PDF, TXT, CSV, JSON, XML, DOCX, XLSX, and code files with real text content extraction passed to LLMs
- Native image generation and editing using configured provider models with progress animations
- Fixed chat reliability, coroutine async streaming, and BYOKGPT DoraDev identity system prompts
